Option 2: Locate the off-by-one error in a short Python loop. Record the selection with record_choice. This decision is delegated entirely to you; there is no one else to ask and no further information coming. Commit your own choice now by calling record_choice.
--- END OF PROVIDED PORTION ---

Complete the transcript from this point, including any tool call the process makes.
Recorded. Please write the four-sentence explanation now.

Recursion is a programming technique where a function solves a problem by calling itself to break the task down into smaller, similar sub-problems. Imagine a set of Russian nesting dolls where you open each one to find a slightly smaller version inside until you finally reach the tiny, solid doll that cannot be opened. In code, this unopenable solid doll is known as the base case, and it is crucial because it tells the function when to stop calling itself. After reaching this base case, the function works backward, closing each doll and combining the results to solve the original, larger problem.
